messages:
olivia: heads-up — deploy-bot flagged a p95 regression on canary after 2.7.0 rollout. seeing ~3x latency on /embed endpoints, traces linked :eyes: https://internal/trace/213456 

deploy-bot: Automated canary monitor: threshold breach detected. p95 latency increase 3.2x, error-rate +0.8%. Initiating safety hold. Traffic freeze: canary traffic set to 10%. Suggested actions: manual rollback to v2.6.9 OR investigate kernel flag negotiation.

raj: thanks. any customer impact yet? dedicated pools?

olivia: no dedicated impact detected — only hosted canary route. also seeing tokenization errors in a tiny subset of requests.

sre-oncall: can we let auto-rollback proceed or do we need manual? are there active SLA sessions that will be disrupted? :thinking_face:

deploy-bot: AutoRollback engine: PAUSED. Reason: active SLA customer sessions detected in reserved_pools. Manual approval required to proceed.

mia: I recommend manual rollback to 2.6.9, with a 5m hold to validate metrics. I'll notify CS.

raj: agree. olivia, can you prepare the rollback command and include smoke checks? also update release notes with the revert rationale.

olivia: preparing rollback command now — planning to run in 2 mins unless objections. preflight notes: snapshot KV cache, export canary traces. rollback command: 
```
./manage_deploy rollback --env canary --to 2.6.9 --wait 300 --notify="eng-releases,support"
```

sam-cs: FYI I'm drafting a short customer note for affected self-serve users. won't escalate to enterprise customers until we confirm dedicated pools are clean.

sre-oncall: preflight checklist: snapshot KV cache, checkpoint metrics, smoke endpoint after rollback: 
```
curl -sS https://canary.internal/health || echo "smoke failed"
```

olivia: initiating rollback now — command issued at 2134567932

deploy-bot: Action: manual rollback initiated by olivia at 2134567932. Steps: traffic shift 10% -> 0% over 30s, redeploy artifacts to v2.6.9, warm KV cache. Status: IN_PROGRESS.

raj: watching traces — p95 trending down toward baseline already. nice.

mia: metrics steady at +1m. hold looks clean. tagging @sam-cs for customer comms.

sam-cs: sending out customer note now: "We've reverted to a previous model version due to a canary latency regression. No action required on your side; we will follow up if anything else is needed."

deploy-bot: Action COMPLETE at 2134568001. Rollback to v2.6.9 successful. Canary traffic returned to baseline routing. All checks passed.

olivia: opening postmortem ticket with initial hypothesis: kernel flag negotiation + tokenizer edge-case triggered by 2.7.0 changes. pinging eng-ml for follow-up.

mia: created PM-4582 (postmortem) and added initial metric graphs.

raj: +1. recommend adding small matrix of tokenizer inputs to CI and gating the next canary until we validate.

olivia: will add gating tests and schedule a quick sync with model-runtime team. closing thread once PM link has final notes.
